docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The journal of D-503 in the glass city of the One State, where people are numbers and every hour is scheduled: the first great dystopia.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Yevgeny Zamyatin (1884–1937), My (Russian), written 1920–1921, translated by Gregory Zilboorg (1890–1959), 1924. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
